subject.title: feat(sessions): add local timezone prefix to archive filenames

question: Should OpenClaw bless `YYYY-MM-DD_<utc>` as the persisted session archive filename contract for configured `userTimezone`, and require sibling QMD/archive-reader support before merge?
rationale: This changes a persisted session artifact naming contract and the linked issue is already a product-direction item; automation can identify the reader gap but cannot choose the permanent filename policy.
